camera.angle_medium_full_body_detail.description: Medium distance full body with visible details
camera.angle_medium_full_body_detail.contents: 6-7 feet distance. Full body head to feet, subject 75-85% frame height. Face and dress details clearly readable. Makeup, embellishments, complete silhouette visible. Floor lower 30%. 30-45deg oblique.

camera.angle_three_quarter_elevated.description: Elevated three-quarter view with detail visibility
camera.angle_three_quarter_elevated.contents: MEDIUM UPPER-BODY FRAMING. Frame includes: complete head, full shoulders and torso, bodice, waist, upper skirt. Bottom of frame CUTS at mid-skirt (hip level). Subject fills 60-70% of vertical frame. Three-quarter view (35-50deg body angle) from elevated overhead angle. Face from above: makeup detail readable. Bodice, sleeves, waist, upper skirt tiers sharp and visible.

camera.angle_elevated_quarter_turn.description: Elevated angle with subject in quarter turn
camera.angle_elevated_quarter_turn.contents: MEDIUM UPPER-BODY FRAMING. Frame includes: complete head, full shoulders and torso, bodice, waist, upper skirt. Bottom of frame CUTS at mid-skirt (hip level). Subject caught mid-turn at 45deg angle filling 60-70% of vertical frame. Face in three-quarter view from elevated overhead: mascara, blush, lip color readable. Upper body and bodice prominent in frame.

camera.angle_medium_overhead_full.description: Medium overhead full body with detail emphasis
camera.angle_medium_overhead_full.contents: 6-8 feet distance. Full body head to feet, subject 75-80% frame. Makeup application, hair details, dress embellishments readable. Floor lower third. 30-45deg oblique.

camera.angle_embellishment_showcase.contents: 7-8 feet distance. Full body positioning with elevated angle. Dress and embellishments in frame.
